'''Niriktavi Bay''' was a bay located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taratos IV]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan]] led a research team to Niriktavi Bay to study the [[Niriktavi coral]], a type of [[Coral/Legends|coral]] that grew in the bay.<ref name="Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref>
